tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// 'khor lo sdom pa lhan skyes lha lnga rga lo lugs kyi dkyil chog dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pa lha lnga rga lo lugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gzod nas yongs grub sku bzhi'i gangs ri las// smin byed dbang bzhi'i chu bo rab bab pas// gnas skabs bzhi yi dri ma kun bkrus nas// rdo rje rnam bzhi grub mdzad des skyongs shig /'di la gnyis/ sngon du bya ba dang*/ las rim dngos so// dang po ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon la slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ yi dam la gnang ba zhus pas gnang ba thob pa'am/ ma bkag pa'i mtshan ma mthong nas slob ma'i bar chad bsrung phyir las sngags byin pa zlos su bcug cing slob ma bsags sbyang la 'bad pa dang yo byad 'tshol du gzhug /slob dpon gyis bsnyen pa kha gso sgrub thabs don gnyis 'dod 'jo ltar nyams su blangs nas gtso bo'i snying po la 'bum dang*/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag re re/ ye shes dbab pa'i sngags khri phrag gcig rnams thems par bya ba ni bsnyen pa kha gso ba'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po la bzhi/ sa/ lha/ bum/ slob ma sta gon no// dang po ni/ gtsug lag khang ngam/ dur khrod dam/ ba glang gi lhas la sogs pa sngon du sbyangs zin pa'i sar ni sa brtag bslang sbyang bzung bsrung rnams mi dgos la/ de las gzhan par ni sa chog rnams dkyil chog gzhan ltar bya'o// sa sta gon dngos ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa gsal bar gyur par bsam/ dkyil 'khor bkram pa'i sa de'i dbus su 'dug pa'i mdun du me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod pa'i mdun du/

mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams/ sa de'i dbus su tshom bu skad cig gis baṃ las byung ba'i sa lha sku mdog ser mo/ rab tu dga' ba'i thugs can zhi ba na bza' dkar po mnabs shing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i rgya dang g.yon gser gyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ pad zla'i gdan la sems skyil gyis bzhugs par bsgom/ rang gi lag pa g.yas par zla ba la hūm̐ gsum bsam pa'i 'od zer dang*/ mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo gzhan gsum brkyang ba'i rtse mo/ hūm̐ brjod pa dang lhan cig sa la lan gsum bsnun pa'i rkyen gyis bskul bas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo ye shes pa spyan drangs/ bsgom pa'i dam tshig pa la thim pas 'dres par gyur pa la/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ chu lhag ma gsum nyer spyod rol mos mchod/ oṃ a kā ro'i sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul nas/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni// lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma// bzang po'i rgyan gyis rnam brgyan ma| |do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes nas su// dkyil 'khor las ni rab grub mdzod// hi hi hi hi haṃ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ de ltar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin pa de nyid du thim par gyur par mos/ lag gnyis rdo rje nang du bsdams pas sa de mnan la/ oṃ badzrī bha wa hūm̐/ lan gsum brjod/ rdo rje bsdams pa las byung ba'i yi ge hūm̐ 'bar ba 'phros pas dbang chen gyi sa 'og gi bar rdo rjer byas par bsam/ oṃ badzra dṛ ḍho tiṣṭha/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas sa de rang gi dbang du bya'o// gnyis pa lha sta gon ni/ gang du ras bris bkram pa'i stegs bu de nyid kyi steng du/

dri bzang dang*/ ba byung*/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lngas khyab par byugs la/ de dag gi gtso bo'i gnas su gru bzhi dang*/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du gtso bo'i phyed tshad kyi zlum por byug cing*/ lha so so'i sngags brjod bzhin pas tshom bu phyogs g.yon skor dang mtshams g.yas skor du bkod pa'i phyi rol tu spyi mchod chu bzhi nyer spyod tshar gcig g.yon skor dang*/ sgos mchod spos mar me lha bshos lha grangs dang mnyam pa spyi mchod kyi nang du bshams/ nang mchod sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi tshom bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyas par na mdun bskyed ltar ram/ bsdu na rnam rgyal bum pa ltar lha gtso 'khor rnams su bskyed/ ye shes pa spyan drangs pa nas rgyas gdab kyi bar mdun bskyed ltar bya/ mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i mchod pa bstod pa dang bcas pa rgyas bsdus skabs sbyar bya/ gtso bo la sngags brgya phrag /'khor la nyer gcig sogs bzla/ 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma sgrub thabs kyi thun mtshams su bshad pa ltar dbul/ snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ pus mo btsugs g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu gsil zhing*/ lce hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur par mos la/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can// ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal// phag mor lhan cig yang dag gnas// gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// ma lus bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma la ni phan pa dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// rdo rje can bdag che ge zhes// nangs par dkyil 'khor dgram par 'tshal// rjes su brtse bas nyer dgongs te// nye ba ru ni mdzad par rigs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ mchod pa rnams gsar du bsham mam kha gsos te bzhugs su gsol/ gsum pa bum pa sta gon ni| bum pa gnyis legs par bkru/ gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab cing khro bo'i sngags bzlas pas bgegs bskrad/ dar ras gsar pa'i mgul chings rnam rgyal la ze prog lnga pa/ las thams cad par gsum pa bcings/ rta glang bong bu sogs kyis ma bgrod cing srog chags med pa'i rgyun 'bab kyi chu la chang dang 'o ma cung zad bsres pas sum gnyis bkang la/ oṃ tapte tapte ma hā tapte swā hā/ zhes lha'i chu bo gaṅgā drangs par bsam/ bum mtshan ni rnam rgyal la chos 'byung gi lte bar sna tshogs padma'i dbus su nyi ma la rdo rje nag po rtse lnga dang*/ las thams cad par sna tshogs pad nyir gri gug gis mtshan pa bri'am bris la gdags/ nang du lnga tshan lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga la oṃ āḥhūm̐ bzlas la blug /mgrin par srad bu dkar po hūm̐ bdun bzlas la bcing*/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan la/ dris byugs pa'i ku sha'i steng du rnam rgyal shar sgo'i g.yon dang las thams cad pa shar sgo'i g.yas sam/ yang na rnam rgyal shar sgo'i thad dang las thams cad pa byang shar du bkod/ rnam rgyal gyi steng du thod pa'i dung chos su bdud rtsi lnga dri'i chu dang sbyar pa/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tod ka ṭha hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ yi ge gsum lan bdun sngags pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir byas pa'i rdo rje'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin dang ldan pas gang bar bsams la bzhag pa'i steng du me tog gi phreng ba bcings pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis sngags pa bkod/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i bum pa gnyis rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gi rnam par gyur pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus dang bum mtshan sna tshogs padma'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ nag po 'od 'bar ba yongs su gyur pa las/

rdo rje nag po rtse lnga ba'i lte bar hūm̐ yig nag po dri ma med pa'i 'od zer 'bar ba/ de'i 'od kyis khams gsum pa'i sems can thams cad kyi rgyud sbyangs nas dpal he ru ka'i go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam par bkug hūm̐ la thim/ sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa sku mdog nag po zhes pa nas/ thod pa dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ las bum gyi dbus dang bum mtshan pad nyi ro'i gdan la pāṃ las gri gug pāṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dum skyes ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig /spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang dum bu lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas spras pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa'i gru mor kha ṭwāṃ gas mtshan pa/ skra sil bur grol ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskums pas gnas pa/ zhes gsal btab/ spyan drang ba sogs ni/ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i zhes pa nas/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi dang dum skyes ma la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams lha so so la thim par gyur gyi bar mdun bskyed ltar bsgom/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ chos dbyings ye shes rang bzhin rnam dag las// sgyu ma'i rnam rol lha mo mchod yon ma// bcom ldan bum pa'i lha tshogs mnyes phyir 'bul// rdo rje mchod yon ma yis mnyes gyur cig /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin chu lhag ma gsum nyer spyod lnga rol mo rnams la sbyar ba dang*/

pi wang ma dang gling bu ma// rdza rnga ma dang rdza rnga che// bzhad mo sgeg mo glu gar mo// me tog ma dang spos 'chang ma/ */ mar me ma dang dri chab ma// me long ma dang ro 'dzin ma// reg bya ma dang chos ldan ma// nam mkha' gang ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs mchod// oṃ badzra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dharma dhā tu'i bar gyis mchod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ oṃ/ bcom ldan dpa' bo'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal// bskal pa chen po'i mtha' yi me lta bu// ral pa'i tshogs kyi cod pan bcings pa ste// mche gtsigs drag cing 'jigs su rung ba'i zhal// phyag ni 'od zer stong phrag 'bar ba po// dgra sta zhags 'phyar mdung dang kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin// stag gi pags pa'i na bza' 'chang bar mdzad// du ba mun chen mdog mtshungs sku la 'dud// oṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo la ni phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma 'jig rten gsum yum gzhan gyis mi thub rig pa'i dbang phyug che// 'byung po thams cad 'jigs mdzad kun tu 'bebs ma rdo rje chen mo nyid// rdo rje gdan ma mi pham gzhan gyis mi thub dbang mdzad g.yo ba'i spyan// dug kyang skem par mdzad ma 'jigs su rung ba'i khro mo gtsigs byed mo// skrag byed gsod byed rab tu 'jigs par byed cing pha rol las rgyal ma// rnam par rgyal ma rmugs par mdzad cing rengs dang rmongs par mdzad pa mo// rdo rje phag mo rnal 'byor chen mo 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma la 'dud// zhi rgyas dbang dang 'gugs pa'i las bzhi dang*// lus tshor sems chos dran pa nyer bzhag rnams// dga' dang mchog dga' dga' bral lhan skyes dga'// snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal// rtag pa la sogs de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi| |bum pa bzhi dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod// mtshams su mchod pa'i gzugs kyis gnas pa yi// thabs shes dbyer med de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang*/

las bum la/ dbang gi las dang dga' bral dang*// chos rjes dran pa'i ngo bo nyid// sku mdog dmar mo drag shul can// khaṇḍa ro he la phyag 'tshal// zhes bstod/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur gyis gzung thag gi sne nas bzung g.yas phreng ba bgrang zhing*/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags phreng spros/ gzung thag la 'khril te song*/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar thim/ lha yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems dkar dmar bab pa dang ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar gyur bar bsams pas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa brgyad brgyad nye snying gang 'grub/ 'khor bzhi'i sngags nyer gcig gam bdun sogs bzla/ slar gzung thag las bum khar spos nas las thams cad pa'i sngags brgya phrag bzla/ thun mong du/ oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang brgya phrag bzla/ mthar rnam rgyal la mchod yon phul nas/ lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes zhu ba byang chub sems kyi ngo bo bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur/ bum mtshan lhar bskyed pa rnams kyang slar mtshan ma'i rnam par gyur/ las bum gyi lhas 'dir ji srid dkyil 'khor la sogs pa'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab/ bsrung ba'i slad du las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i me tog dkar po gsum gsum bum pa gnyis su bcug la spos kyis bdug go// bum pa gnyis nas chu cung zad bsdus pa thod pa'am dung chos su blugs la mna' chu'i ched du rnam rgyal gyi steng du bzhag go// bzhi pa slob ma sta gon ni/ sta gon gyi maṇḍal dang bum pa la sogs pa mi mthong bar yol ba sogs kyis bsgrib/ slob ma nang gshin pa bslab gzhi lnga 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa yan chad la gnas pa dgos/ sngar ma thob na 'dir byin la gral la 'khod/ sbyang chas rnams 'du byas la/ dang po bgegs sbyang ba ni/

gtor chung gsum la chu bran/ oṃ a kā ro'i sngags gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma re re nas slob ma la g.yas g.yon du skor ram/ bu ston gyis phyi la skor gsungs pa ltar bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bighnāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes gsog snod du dor/ mar me dang changs bu yang gong ltar bskor zhing hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod dril bu gsil gsog snod du dor/ mthar| rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug cing byang chub bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ gnod pa dang gdug pa'i sems zhi zhing*/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang so so'i gnas su song zhig /ces hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags bzla/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug go// sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu/ dbus su til bkod/ slob ma'i rkang zhabs su rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ lte bar gtum mo ye shes kyi me/ snying gar sdig pa'i ngo bo paṃ yig nag po gsal bar lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad bsdus te paṃ la bstims/ rkang zhabs rlung dkyil las rlung g.yos pas lte ba'i me sbar ba'i me lces paṃ yig ded pa sna sgo nas thon/ til la thim par gyur par bsam/ me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa'i nang du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su/ khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'i ljags la raṃ yig gis mtshan pa'i zhal du phul bas gsol bar bsam/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gyis til bzung ba g.yas dang g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/

zhes bzla zhing*/ g.yas kyis me'i nang gi khro bo'i zhal dang g.yon gyis rgya mtsho'i chur dor bar bsam pa lan gsum sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badzra muḥs khro bo gshegs/ chu me nang du blug go/ /de nas las sngags bzla zhing las thams cad pas slob ma rnams khrus bya/ lag tu me tog bzung*/ pus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs te 'khod du bcug pa la/ bsam pa bzang po bskyed pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten 'di nyid kyi mngon par mtho ba don du gnyer ba ma yin/ 'jig rten pha rol tu mngon par mtho ba'i ched du'ang ma yin gyi/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsum gyi phun sum tshogs pa 'thob par bya ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o// de lta na mngon par mtho ba gnyis kyang thob par 'gyur ro// des na bsam pa rab 'bring tha gsum las 'dir ni rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang 'thob par bya ba'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug par bya'o snyam du soms shig /ces brjod/ spro na sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// sogs tshigs bcad kyang brjod la brda bkrol te bshad/ de nas slob dpon he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pa slob ma la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs nas 'od du zhu ba slob dpon gyi khar zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas thon te yum gyi padmar gtso bo zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par gnas pa la/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yum dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu bas slob ma la dbang bskur ba padma nas bton te lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi khang ba'i sgor gnas par bsams la/ slob mas maṇḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ slob ma'i gtso bo gcig la bos pa'i tshul gyis/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang*// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa rnams// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// skyob pa shākya seṅge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// 'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas su// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces spro ba bskyed/ slob mas thal mo sbyar te/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// nas/ sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar sgrub thabs ltar lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa gzung*/ slob dpon gyis/ gong nas gong du sdom pa ni// bu khyod kyis ni gzung bar bya// 'khor ba las ni sgrol ba yi// thabs ni de las gzhan med pas// de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis// sdom pa rtag tu bskyang bar gyis// des ni gnod pa rnams bsal nas/ byang chub bde ba rnams thob 'gyur// zhes lan gcig gis sdom pa bsgrags/ slob mas lag tu me tog dang bcas pas de 'dzin 'dod kyi bsam pas slob dpon gyi spyan sngar/ sangs rgyas sras bcas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla na med| |dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa la// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// deng nas brtsams te gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje'i rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs can dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces gsum gyis sdom pa gzung*/

las sngags kyis bsrungs te/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du zla ba la gnas pa'i snying gar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par padma dmar po'i lte bar āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar oṃ dkar po rnams gsal btab/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pa g.yas pas gnas de gsum du dri'i thig le bya zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su| |'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos bar// mchod pa thams cad dang ldan pas// dus kun tu ni bde bar mnos// zhes brjod nas mgor me tog /spos/ mar me/ zhal zas dbul/ dri thugs kar so so'i sngags kyis sbyin no// de nas 'o ma can gyi shing skyon rnams dang bral ba sor bcu gnyis pa srad bu dmar pos bcings shing rtse mor me tog phreng ba btags pa/ las sngags bzlas te slob mar gtad/ des kyang ba lci dang dris ba lang gi ko ba tsam du byugs pa'i maṇḍal khru gang*/ gru bzhi pa/ phyogs mtshams mi 'chol ba'i mtshan ma bkod pa'i steng du kha shar ram byang du blta ba'i rtse mo bca' zhing skyon dag par bsams nas thal mo sbyar bas/ oṃ badzra hā sa hā/ zhes brjod la steng du lta zhing ltos pa med par dor/ de yang rtse mo bdag nyid la bstan na mchog /gyen du bsgrengs na mkha' spyod/ thur du bltas na sa 'og spyod/ shar du bltas na dngos grub 'bring*/ byang dang mtshams bzhir 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub/ lho dang nub tu dngos grub chung ngu*// phyi rol tu lhung na dngos grub med do// zhes lung bstan/ chu gtsang gis kha bshal nas/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i dri chu khyor pa gsum/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddhaḥsarba dharmaḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsā sya sho dhā ya sarba bi kalpa na a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod la blud/ de nas yi ge hūm̐ las byung ba'i srad bu dmar po'am/ ser po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam pa mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa/

las sngags bdun bzlas pa dpung pa g.yon par/ oṃ badzra mai tri rakṣa rakṣa sarbāṃ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing bcing*/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis bsrung*/ chos zab mo la spro ba bskyed pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u duṃ wā ra'i me tog bzhin// rgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// de kun dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra ba// mthong bas 'byang bar 'gyur lags na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i| |tshul la gnas pas smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros brtan zhing mi g.yo ba| |de dag gis ni ngan 'gro'i rgyun// sdug bsngal kun 'byung rab tu bcad// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i| |bdag nyid chen po kun gyis ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen las// sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung skal pa chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes don bshad// oṃ ha la sogs ba'i go bskon/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis de la bsrung ngo*// de nas hūm̐ las byung zhing las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i ku sha rtse mo ma nyams pa yi ge dhīḥlas skyes par bsams la| las thams cad pa bzlas te/ oṃ badzra tīkṣ+ṇa baṃ/ zhes che ba stan dang chung ba sngas su sbyin/

las thams cad pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i don du byin la/ khang pa'i nang dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i mthar yol ba sogs kyis bcad pa'i phyi'am/ gnas gzhan du seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la gsol ba btab nas las thams cad pa'i sngags bzla bzhin par nyal la/ rmi lam bzang ngan gang mthong ba de nangs par smros shig ces bsgos la nyal du gzhug /slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa bsrung ba'i don du las thams cad pa'i sngags bzla bar bya'o// nangs par snga bar langs te slob ma'i rmi lam dris la/ bzang na gzengs bstod/ ri las lhung ba sogs ngan pa rmis na/ zhing skyong dang mkha' 'gro ma sogs la gtor ma phul la bar gcod zhi bar gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ sgrub thabs ltar srung 'khor sgom zhing hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags sogs sngags rnams bzla/ slob dpon bdag nyid go cha gsum gyis bsrung*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams la bar chad zhi ba'i phyir gsol ba gdab/ yab kyi rtsa sngags sogs brjod cing rus rgyan gyon la dpa' bo'i nga rgyal gyis zhi ba'i sbyin sreg la sogs pa bya'o// nangs par snga bar langs nas dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyi mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs pa rtse sprad pa kha 'og tu phyogs pa spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐ badzrottiṣṭha bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur par mos/ tshom bu bsdu/ bum pa gnyis dben par ras sogs kyi gdan la mchod pa dang bcas bzhag */ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bsrung*/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi der las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i dri bzang dang bdud rtsi lngas byugs pa'i steng du ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor legs par bkram/ brtag gnyis las/ rdul mtshon bri bar ma nus na// dkyil 'khor dang mnyam ras la ni// nges par bcom ldan he ru kaḥ /phyag rgya'i tshogs dang bcas pa bri// zhes gsungs pas/

ras bris la lha gtso 'khor zhal phyag rgyan chas sogs rdzogs par bris pa rang dgos so/ mchan/ de'i phyi rol du rang gi g.yon nas brtsams g.yon skor du chu bzhi dung chos/ mngon brjod bla ma'i rab gnas skabs/ argha'i snod ni thod pa'o// mchod yon rus pa'i tsurṇa ste// zhes gsungs pas/ chu bzhi'i snod ni thod pa'am dung chos gang rung dang*// nas dang*/ 'o ma dang*/ me tog dkar po dang*/ rtswa ku sha dang*/ til dang*/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ 'bras yos dang*/ dri bzang sbyar ba'i phye ma'i arghaṃ dang*/ khyad par mi rus kyi phye ma btab cing rdzas de rnams chu bzhi kar btab bo zhes bu ston gsungs so| |mchan/ 'thor 'thung ma gtogs gzhan gsum la mdun du bzed zhal re re/ 'thor 'thung la ku sha'i chun pos brgyan pa dang*/ nyer spyod lnga rnams bsham/ mngon brjod bla ma'i rab gnas kyi skabs su/ ba sas kyi ni mar me bya// dpa' bo chen po'i bdug spos dang*// klad pas lha bshos bya ba ste// dri chen rdo rje chu yi dri// zhes nang gi nyer spyod dang*/ yang mngon brjod du/ me tog sna tshogs yid 'ong ba// dri dang bdug pa de bzhin gos// mar me phreng ba yid 'ong ba// phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ zhes phyi'i nyer spyod kyang snod so sor bshams pa legs so// zhes bu ston gsungs so// mchan/ de dag gi nang du lha so so'i sgos mchod lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i spos/ mar me/ zhal zas kyang bsham/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i g.yon du rnam rgyal dang g.yas su las bum/ yang na mdun du rnam rgyal/ byang shar du las thams cad pa bsham/ gang ltar yang bum pa gnyis nges par rdo ra'i nang du 'god par bshad/ gzhan yang bu ston gyis/ khyad par du mar me gtso bo yin pas thun mong du mar me brgya dang*/ zhun chen gyi mar me brgya dbul/ gos zung sna tshogs dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsrung phyir ku sha dang rus rgyan sogs nye 'khor du bkod/

ces gsungs pas mar me de gnyis brgya phrag re ma 'dzom yang ci mang mchod pa'i mthar bskor/ bla bre/ 'phan/ gdugs/ yol ba/ rgyal mtshan/ me tog gi phreng ba/ rin po che la byas pa'i rgyal srid bdun la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad ci 'byor ba yang g.yon skor du bkod legs par bshams/ sha rlon sogs kyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma gnyis sogs kyang bshams/ gtor ma ni nya sha dang sha chen dang sgog btsong sna tshogs kyis sbags pa bya/ de bde mchog dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag rnam pa gsum la sogs par ci 'byor ba bshams pa bu ston gsungs so// mchan/ mchod rdzas de thams cad la sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas sbags/ mchod gtor thams cad la yi ge gsal/ bzlas pa'i nang mchod kyis gtor/ mchan/ gu gul gyis bdug cing*/ yi ge gsum dang*/ mchan/ las thams cad pa dang gtso bo'i sngags yig bdun/ mchan/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas shing*/ ma grub na lan bdun/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ zhes dgod/ gzhan yang dbang rdzas rnams dang*/ cang te'u/ rdor dril rang gi mdun du rdor dril/ g.yas su cang te'u/ g.yon du nang mchod bsham zhes/ bu ston gsungs/ mchan/ sbyar ba'i spos dang nang mchod la sogs pa nyer mkho thams cad ma tshang ba med par slob dpon gyi nye logs su bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba'o// dang po la gsum/ bdag /bum/ mdun bskyed do// dang po bdag bskyed ni/ sgrub thabs don gnyis 'dod 'jo'i nang mchod byin rlabs nas bzung*/ chu zla lta bur gyur/ shrī he ru ko3haṃ gi bar rdzogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bum pa skad cig tsam gyis bskyed pa dang*/ sngar bum pa sta gon gyi skabs ltar rgyas par bskyed pa gnyis long skabs dang bstun la gang mos bya'o// gsum pa ni/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor khaṇḍa ro hes bsangs/ swa bhā wa dang*/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung dkar po nas/ mnyam nyid ye shes kyi bar dang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can phyung*/ srog rtsol gyi rlung dang lhan cig sna bug g.yas nas spros/ zla ba dbyangs gsal dang bcas pa'i bar du zhugs pa rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin zhes sbyang zhing chos dbyings ye shes so// zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i ra gur 'jig dus kyi me nas nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa/ nas/ thod pa dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur gyi bar brjod la gsal btab/ sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa ras bris kyi lha la bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las kha dog sna tshogs 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa spros pas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa'i tshogs dang*/ dbang gi lha gdan gsum tshang ba rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa so sor thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung*/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ nas/ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces pa'i bar gyis go bgo/ dbang gi lha rnams nam mkhar bzhugs pa la rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di rnams la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ ces pa nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar la/ dbang gi lha rnams lha so so la thim par gyur par bsam/ mchod pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar byin gyis brlabs te/

dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ zhabs bsil/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ ā tsa mā naṃ/ prokṣa ṇaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ zhes chu bzhi dang*/ me tog 'di rnams bzang zhing dge// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod| |oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ nags tshal las byung ro yi mchog /gang zhig dri yi bdug spos mchog /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri// shangs la tshim byed dag pa 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ bshos gtsang bza' dang bca' bar bcas// kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/ sil snyan la sogs rol mo'i tshogs| |dbyangs kyi nga ror ldan pa 'di// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags na// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra shapad pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ swā hā/

zhes dang*/ rang he ru ka yab yum snyoms 'di mai tri pa dang lwa ba pa'i lugs yin par bu ston gsungs so// par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas lha mo bcu drug spros te dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur par bsam/ rdo rje lha mo pi wang brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog sngo// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ badzra wī ṇi huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du pi wang*/ brdung dang*/ sngo dang*/ wī ṇi'i mal rnams su/ rdo rje lha mo gling bu 'bud/ mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog ser// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ badzra waṃ she huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo rnga chen brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog dmar// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod// oṃ badzra mṛ taṃ ge huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rdo rje lha mo rdza rnga brdung*// mtha' gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams// rol pa'i lha mo sku mdog ljang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mchod| |oṃ badzra mu rañdze huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzhad pa rdo rje lha mo ni// dmar skya phyag gnyis bzhad dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par rol// oṃ badzra hā sya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgeg pa rdo rje lha mo ni// sngon mo phyag gnyis sgeg dang bcas/ mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par rol// oṃ badzra lā sya huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ glu yi rdo rje lha mo ni// ser mo ting ting shag dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par rol// oṃ badzra gī ti huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gar gyi rdo rje lha mo ni// ljang gu phyag gnyis gar dang bcas// mtha' gnyis thod pa cang te'u brdung*// gsang ba mchog gi dgyes par rol// oṃ badzra nṛ tyai huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

mdog dkar rdo rje me tog ni| |g.yas na me tog cang te'u dang*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings mnyes mdzod// oṃ badzra puṣpe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdog mthing rdo rje bdug spos ni// g.yas na bdug spos cang te'u dang*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings mnyes mdzod// oṃ badzra dhū pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa// mdog dmar rdo rje mar me ni// g.yas na mar me cang te'u dang*| |g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings mnyes mdzod// oṃ badzra dī pe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mdog ljang rdo rje dri chab ni// g.yas na dri chab cang te'u dang*// g.yon na thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /mchog rnams rdo rje dbyings mnyes mdzod// oṃ badzra gandhe huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gzugs kyi rdo rje me long bsnams// dkar mo g.yas mtha' cang te'u dang*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ rū pa badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ro yi rdo rje mkhar gzhong bsnams// dmar mo g.yas mtha' cang te'u dang*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ ra sa badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ reg bya'i rdo rje na bza' bsnams// ljang gu g.yas mtha' cang te'u dang*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga |bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ sparshe badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ chos dbyings rdo rje chos 'byung ma// dkar mo g.yas mtha' cang te'u dang*// g.yon pa thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga /bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ dharma dhā tu badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ slar yang 'dod yon lnga'i lha mo dpag tu med pa spros te mchod par gyur par bsams la/ rab 'byam zhing na gzugs kyi dbye ba gsum// mchog dman bar ma'i khyad par ci mchis pa// gzugs kyi rdo rjer sprul nas mchod par bgyi// gzugs snang gzugs kyi rdo rjer grol bar shog /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra rū pa kā ma gu ṇa badzra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

de bzhin du gzugs kyi gnas su/ sgra/ rū pa'i gnas su/ shapad/ dri/ gandhe/ ro/ ra sa/ reg bya/ sparshe/ gzhan yang*/ stong gsum phyogs bcu'i zhing khams mtha' yas su// lhun gyis grub pa'i 'khor lo rin po che// dpag yas 'byor pa'i tshogs dang lhan cig tu// he ru ka dpal 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra tsakra ratna pra tītstsha hūm̐/ de bzhin du 'khor lo'i gnas su/ nor bu/ tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi/ btsun mo/ st+rī/ blon po/ gṛ ha pa ti/ glang po/ hasti/ rta mchog /tu raṃ ga a shwa/ dmag dpon/ pa ri ṇā ya ka/ zhes 'bul ba phyi'i mchod pa'o// slar yang*/ rnal 'byor ma bzhis sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i thod pa thogs pa mtha' yas pa spros pas dkyil 'khor pa la mchod par gyur par mos/ yum lnga'i rang bzhin dri chen klad pa byang sems rakta dri yi chu// yab lnga'i rang bzhin ba lang khyi glang rta dang mi yi sha rnams ni// sbyangs spel sbar bsgyur bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dri ro nus kun ldan// mkha' mnyam thod pa bkang bas rab mchod zag med bde bas mnyes gyur cig /mchod do/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi zhes pa nas/ ātma ko3haṃ gi bar gyis nang mchod thigs gtor 'bul/ slar yang*/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis// rdo rje nyi ma padmar byung*// me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa// rdo rje gsum gyi dam tshig mchog /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min zhing*// lte bar gtum mo'i me yis ni// nges par bsregs pa de ni spos// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// dhū paṃ= yi ge hūm̐ las yang dag byung*// sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu gsal// mar me 'bar ba yang dag 'od// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// dī paṃ= bde ba chen po'i gzhi la gnas// byang chub sems ni sad pa dang*// de nyid kyis kyang byug pa dag

/thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// gandhaṃ= 'dir ni gang dang gang longs spyod/ */dbang po thams cad yang dag brten// de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje// bza' ba'i snod du mchod par bya// nai wi dyaṃ= rdo rje padma yang dag sbyar// zhugs pa la sogs rim las byung*// rnal 'byor pa yi mi shigs sgra// thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya// shapad= zhes pa nang gi mchod pa'o// slar yang dkyil 'khor pa'i gtso bo yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhes pa nas/ nyams su myong bar gyur/ lta dang dgod dang lag 'dzin dang*// 'khyud dang gnyis sprod sogs mchod pas// dbang bskur bar ni 'gyur ba dang*// rgyud rnams kun gyi don rtogs shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes rjes chags kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pa gsang mchod do// de nas/ mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams// gang tshe tha dad mi dmigs pa// de 'dir mchod pa chen po ste// bla med mchod pas mchod par bya// rang bzhin med pa'i gnas goms las// lha yi snying po sgom byed pa// de ni mchod pa chen por 'dod// sangs rgyas thams cad rtogs byed pa'o// zhes 'khor gsum dmigs med du bsam pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ */ chos kyi dbyings las 'gyur ba med rtags su// sku mdog mthing nag cung zad sngo ba'i mdangs// byang chub sems dang stong nyid dbyer med pa// rtag chad 'gro 'ong bral la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhan cig skyes pa bde ba chen po'i sku// bdud rtsi ro yis nges gang tshul bstan pa// mchog la phan mdzad rdo rje phag mo dang*// gnyis med rol par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum bgrad pa'i tshul// phyag g.yas rdo rjes rnam rtog rtsad nas 'joms| |phyag g.yon dril bus dngos por 'dzin pa spong*// snang stong dbyer med 'khyud la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'jig rten spyod grol dbu skra gyen du bcings// ye shes lnga ldan thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan// chos nyid thugs chud rdo rje'i thag pas brgyus// yul dang yul can dbyer med khyod la 'dud// 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos padma'i gdan| |byang chub myu gu smin byed nyi steng du// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan// ma rungs tshar gcod mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// sgrib gnyis sreg mdzad me dpung nang na bzhugs// nyon mongs gdung sel zla ba phyed pas spras// phrin las bzhi yis sems can don mdzad phyir// sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan la phyag 'tshal bstod// yid bzhin re skong nor bu gtsug na 'dzin// pha rol phyin drug rdzogs pa'i phyag rgya drug

/mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pa'i skur gsal ba// mi bskyod dbu rgyan can la phyag 'tshal bstod// spang bya spangs dang gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir// stag gi pags pa mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan// bdud bzhi 'joms phyir rno dkar mche ba gtsigs// thugs rjes 'dzum bcas khros la phyag 'tshal bstod| |khams bzhi rnam dag mkha' 'gro chen mo bzhi// phyogs bzhir gnas nas las bzhi sgrub pa dang*// ye shes bzhi yi rang gzugs mkha' 'gro ma// mdzes ma dum skyes gzugs can ma la bstod// mtshams bzhir gnas pa'i stobs can lngas gang ba'i// bum thod bzhi yis mchog gi bde stsol zhing*// ye shes lnga yi rang snang gzhal yas khang*// rten dang brten par bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshogs brgyad dag pa dur khrod chen po brgyad// phyogs skyong zhing skyong shing dang chu klung sprin// ri dang mchod rten mi ro 'byung po'i tshogs// mi mthun srung skyob bsrung ba'i 'khor lor bstod// gdod nas dag pa bde chen ye shes nyid// lam du lha yi 'khor lo gsal dag bstan// 'bras bu bde chen 'khor lor bdag gyur nas// khams gsum bde ba mchog la sbyor bar shog /ces sam/ yang na/ chos dbyings bde ba'i rang bzhin mchog /dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid can// mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod// lhan skyes ye shes ngo bo nyid// zag med bde ba'i rang bzhin can// 'khor 'das dngos po kun gyi yum// rdo rje phag mor phyag 'tshal bstod// lus rjes dran dang dga' ba'i bdag /chu yi khams ni rnam dag pa// rdo rje rigs kyi yum gyur ma// mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshor ba rjes dran mchog dga'i dngos// rlung gi khams ni rnam dag pa// las kyi rigs kyi yum gyur pa// rab mdzes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// chos rjes dran dang dga' bral nyid// me yi khams ni rnam dag pa// padma'i rigs kyi yum gyur pa// dum skyes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// sems rjes dran dang lhan skyes mchog

/sa yi khams ni rnam dag pa// rin chen rigs kyi yum gyur pa// gzugs can ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// bde gshegs bzhi yi ngo bo nyid// bdud rtsi bum par legs gnas pa'i// byang chub sems kyis gang ba yi// thod pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// byang chub phyogs rnams yongs rdzogs pa// bde chen thar pa mchog gi ni// gzhal med khang la phyag 'tshal bstod// tshogs brgyad dag pa ye shes kyi// cho 'phrul las byung dur khrod dang*// gzung 'dzin rtog pas mi phyed pa'i// bsrung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod/ yab yum gyi sngags bzhi brgya stong ci 'grub dang*/ 'khor gyi sngags kyang ci 'grub bzla ste/ de yang lha sku la dmigs nas bzla'o// de nas gtor ma gtang ba ni/ spros pa la dga' na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sgrub khang nang dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma phyi rol tu gtong ba so sor bya ba sgrub thabs gzhan ltar bya/ spros pa la mi dga' na 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa gnyis ka'i gtor ma lhan cig sgrub khang nyid du bya ste/ sgrub thabs kyi thun mtshams su gtor ma 'bul ba'i cho ga kho nas gtor ma gtsang sar 'bul ba'i bar bya'o// de nas tsog pur 'dug pa'i lag gnyis pus mo'i nang du son par byas pa'i g.yon pas dri bzang gi chu'i snod bzung*/ g.yas thal mo bkan pa'i gung mo dang ming med cung zad bskums pa chu la reg nas mi smra bar kha la mang du byab cing*/ mig gnyis/ sna bug gnyis/ lag pa dang*/ lto ba dang*/ mgo bo rnams su lan gsum nye reg byas la nang du 'ong ngo*// hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod cing rdo rje shugs kyi sngags rgyas rtsig pa bteg pa'i 'og nas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs te/ rdo rje gsor dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ/ dngos grub kun gyi bde ba nyams dga' ba'i// thar pa'i grong du bcom ldan bde chen 'jug

/mchog tu bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyi// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrab tu grub par mdzod// ces spro ba bskyed pas zhugs nas gtso bo'i gzugs kyis dkyil 'khor pa rnams la g.yon du lan gsum bskor bar bsam/ slar me tog gi phreng ba thogs te/ oṃ/ mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan// sgeg pa'i gzugs kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'khyud// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhi hi hi hi hīḥ /mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes su gsol// zhes bcom ldan 'das la me tog dbul/ de nas rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis dkyil 'khor gyi nang gi nub nas shar/ de bzhin du lho nas byang*/ shar nas nub/ byang nas lho'i sgo rnams rim gyis phye bar dmigs la sgo phye ba'i rgyas/ oṃ badzroṅghā ṭa sa ma ya pra we sha ya hūm̐/ zhes lan bzhi brjod/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang*/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ gtso bo la phyag byas te/ oṃ sa ma ya pra we sha yā mi/ zhes sngar phul pa'i me tog de nyid gar byed cing bslangs te/ phreng ba'i dbang gi don du rang gi mgor bcing*/ sems can thams cad la dngos grub thams cad kyi bka' drin mdzod cig /ces gsol ba btab bo/ de nas slob ma la ji tsam sbyin pa'i dbang thams cad blang dgos te/ rang gi rtsa ba'i rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pas slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ gtso bo las spros pa'i lha las kyi rdo rje'i bya ba mdzad par bsams pas/ maṇḍal dang gsol gdab nas bzung bzhi pa'i mthar thug pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar blang*/ bsdu na sngags tshig rnams brjod/ dag pa rnams dor/ gang ltar byed kyang dmigs pa tsam byas pas grub na'ang*/ dbang rdzas rnams dngos su blang ba rnam dpyod legs so// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos slob dpon gyi las la gnang ba thob par bsam te bden pa de kho na nyid kyi bstod pa sngon du 'gro bas gsol btab mdor bsdus pa ni/

rdor dril 'dzin pas/ sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid// 'dod mchog dam tshig mchog gyur pa'i// bden pa gang gi ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor yin// bden pa de yis mgon khyod kyis// bdag gi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod| |ces pa 'di ni slob ma mi gzhug kyang rang nyid bdag 'jug blangs pa'i rjes su'ang bya dgos la/ slob ma 'jug na de'i mthar/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes// bden pa de yi dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ gnyis pa slob mar dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ dbang bskur dngos so// dang po la gnyis/ phyi 'jug dang*/ nang 'jug go// dang po ni/ lhag gnas byas pa'i slob ma rnams las kyi rdo rjes las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus khrus bya/ dri bzang pos byug /gos gtsang ma bgos nas dkyil 'khor khang pa'i sgo drung ngam yol ba'i phyi rol tu gral du 'khod pa rnams/ rnam snang ngam gtso bo'i gzugs su gsal ba la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nutta ra bo dhi a laṃ kā ra wast+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes smad g.yogs dang*/ las thams cad pa'i sngags dang*/ oṃ badzra rakṣa hūm̐/ zhes bzlas pas stod g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badzra uṣṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ bzlas pas gtsug tor dang*/ las thams cad pa bzlas pas mig dar dmar po/ oṃ tsakṣurbahandha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐/ zhes mig bcing*/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes me tog gi phreng ba gtad pa bzung nas yon dang maṇḍal dbul/ las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i chus bsangs lag pa rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud du sbrel nas/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bidma he bidyā rā dzā ya dhīḥm he swā hā/

zhes dpa' bo bskul ba'i sngags brjod| sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa yi// lha rnams la ni phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ las thams cad pa'i chus bsangs/ gnas gsum du dri'i chus mas yar thig le bya zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas/ snying gar rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la āḥdamar po/ spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po rnams gsal ba/ de'i 'od zer gyis lus 'od gsal bar byas par bsam/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i thad du bzhag pa la/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dri/ slob mas/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes lan smras pas rigs nges par bya/ sgrub thabs ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum byas la thun mong gi sdom pa gzung*/ sngags su sems bskyed pa ni/ slob ma'i snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba'i dbus su don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pas mtshan par bsams la/ slob mas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ zhes thams cad rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa brtan phyir rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod/ skabs 'dir sta gon du bshad pa ltar rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum bya/ spyir gsang bar gdams pa ni rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ deng khyod la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba 'di khyod kyis dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes gdams/

gnyis pa ni/ las thams cad pa'i sngags dang*/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag pas slob ma khrid la yol ba'i nang du bcug /sgom don dkyil 'khor gyi sgo'i nang du zhugs par bsam/ slob dpon gyis sngar gyi dpa' bo bskul ba'i sngags brjod cing*/ mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i 'dren// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo che/ */ bde ba chen po'i pho brang 'dir// bu khyod bdag gis drangs pa'o// zhes brjod/ slob mas/ ma hā ra ta su dṛ ḍho su to ṣya su su kho badzra satwa ādya siddhya māṃ/ zhes brjod cing dkyil 'khor la g.yon skor lan gsum byas la thal mo snying gar sbyar nas/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing yan lag thams cad 'dud pa'i phyag gsum gtso bo la bya/ de nas thal mo gnas gsum du sbyar nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes gsum gyis slob dpon dang lha thams cad la phyag bya/ de nas slob dpon dang lha tha mi dad pa'i nga rgyal gyis langs te/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gnas pa la dam bsgrag pa ni mgor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang 'di dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon dang*/ snying gar me tog dang bcas pa'i rdo rje bzung nas/ oṃ/ de ring he ru ka dpal che// khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes nyes dmigs dang*/

rnam rgyal steng gi dung chos sam thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu thogs nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig nyams na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thung zhig /oṃ pañtsa a mṛ tod ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes 'thung du gzhug pa ni gnyis ka'i'o// lag par rdo rje gtad la/ deng nas brtsams te dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces gang bsgo ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang mi bya ste/ khyod ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes pa slob dpon bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o// ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob mas/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i rkang mthil du yaṃ/ lte bar aṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ mgrin par oṃ/ spyi bor haṃ rnams gsal ba'i yaṃ las rlung g.yos pas lte ba'i aṃ las me sbar/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang mgrin pa'i oṃ bsregs/ spyi bo'i haṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pa'i bde ba dang*/ aṃ las sbar ba'i me drod kyis lus sems thams cad bde drod stong ba'i ye shes kyis khyab pas yul snang thams cad bde stong du thim zhing*/ snying gar hūm̐ 'od 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis stong gsum phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i rnam par nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad khengs par spyan drangs/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas zhugs shing thim par gyur par dpon slob gnyis kas rtse gcig tu mos/ zla mtshan 'gos pa'i 'dom dkris/ ro ras/ byi la'i brun/ bdud rtsi lnga/ yi dwags kyi kha nas byung ba'i gu gul rnams sbyar ba thod phor du ro sol gyi me la bsregs pa rdo rje dang lhan cig slob dpon gyis lag g.yas su thogs/

g.yon dril bu gsil/ g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'am/ yang na las kyi rdo rjes spos bdug /slob dpon gyis ḍā dril rnam pa brgyar dkrol zhing*/ gtso bo'i snying po dang*/ nye snying gi mthar/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī badzra ā we sha ya st+waṃ bha ya/ to ṣa ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya a aḥhrīḥpāṃ/ zhes bsgyings pas brjid bag dang bcas brgya'i bar du brjod cing dbab/ des ma bab na/ ra'i spu/ pags pa/ sha/ rus| rkang*/ mar khu chen po/ gu gul chen po rnams cha mnyam chang dang gu gul bsres par rdo rje phag mo'i sngags bzlas pa thod phor du ro sol gyi mer sreg cing*/ oṃ tiṣṭha ma hā kro dha ā we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bidma he bidyā rā dzā ya dhīḥm he swā hā/ zhes bzla zhing rol mo drag po dang bcas te dbab/ rtags ni sku bab na rdo rje'i gar dang*/ mkha' la 'gro ba dang*/ 'dar ba dang*/ 'phar ba dang*/ rgyug pa sogs dang*/ gsung bab na sngon med pa'i tshigs bcad smra ba dang*| dgod pa dang*/ ngu ba dang*/ rdo rje'i glu len pa sogs dang*/ thugs bab na dus gsum gyi shes bya shes pa dang*/ snying rje dang ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye ba sogs 'byung*/ de nas rdo rje mgo bor bzhag cing*/ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brjod cing brtan par bya'o// de nas slob ma dkyil 'khor la phyogs pa gdong g.yogs kyi 'og nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar snang du ltar bcug par/ khyod kyi mig lam ji ltar snang*// zhes dri/ dkar/ ser/ dmar/ nag gang snang*/ zhi| rgyas/ dbang*/ drag 'grub pa'i skal can du go ba bskyed/ slob ma'i mthe bong gnyis nas slob dpon gyi lag g.yas pas bzung*/ las thams cad pa bzla zhing rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor la g.yon skor byas nas/ shar sgor phyogs pa la/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dag /bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog

/'di yis dngos grub gang thob dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba// de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces bden stobs brjod/ sngar gtad pa'i me tog gi phreng ba las/ yang zhing ma rnying ba'i me tog cig thal mo'i bar du bzung ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis 'od gsal zhing sdig pa bkrus par gnyis kas bsams la/ gus pa dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i shugs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs nas gtso bo'i mdun du gnas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ pra tītstsha badzra hoḥ zhes gtso bo'i dbu la phul bar bsams la dkyil 'khor du ltos pa med par dor/ de yang*/ lha'i mdzod spu'am| dbu'am/ gtsug tor la bab na mchog gi dngos grub/ spyan nam zhal la sngags kyi dngos grub/ sku stod la dngos grub chen po/ bar gyi cha la 'bring*/ smad cha la tha ma/ sku la nye na dngos grub myur/ ring na ring*/ lha gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang la nye ba de'i rigs/ mnyam na gang la mos pa de'i rigs/ rtsig pa'i steng ngam phyir lhung na lan gsum bskyar la dor/ bskyar yang de nyid du bab na dngos grub phra mo yin/ rdo ra'i nang du lhung yang dngos grub phra mo/ de'i phyi rol du lhung na dngos grub med pas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa yang ma gnang gi/ dbang bskur ba lta ga la rung*/ zhes lung bstan/ slar me tog de nyid me tog gi phreng ba dang lhan cig /oṃ pra ti gṛhṇa st+waṃ/ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes slob ma'i mgor bcings/ 'di ni me tog gi phreng ba'i dbang ste/ me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs nges pas slob ma de bzhin gshegs pa gang gi rigs su nges par bya ba'i ched du'o// mig dbye ba ni/ slob ma'i snying gar nyi ma la hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ/ mig gnyis la oṃ 'od zer 'bar ba/ oṃ de'i 'od zer gyis bkug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams dang lhan cig rdo rje drag po slob ma'i snying gar bcug la/

oṃ/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur te// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dngos// grub kun khyod la mngon du gyur| |dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// sngags kyi dngos grub brtson par gyis/ zhes dang*/ 'og tu chos 'byung dkar po nam mkha'i khams kyi nang rlung me chu ri rab kyi steng du/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang du ye shes kyi me ri dang rdo rje'i rwa gur rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su sna tshogs padma dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang 'od zer tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i nang sna tshogs padma dang zla ba dbugs bral gyi gdan la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma/ byang du rab mdzes ma/ nub tu dum skyes ma/ lhor gzugs can ma/ mtshams bzhir bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du sha lngas gang ba'i thod pa/ dbus su pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mos 'khyud pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa bzhugs pa mngon sum mthong bar brda sprad cing*/ de'i nang nas khyed lha 'di la me tog phog pas khyod ni rigs de yin no// zhes bstan/ de nas slob mas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag zhugs so// rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po bdag gis mthong*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen por bdag dbang bskur// hoḥhoḥhoḥ zhes dam tshig brjod du bcug pas dkyil 'khor bstan to// gnyis pa la bzhi/ bum/ gsang*/ shes rab/ bzhi pa'o// dang po la gnyis/

slob ma dang*/ slob dpon gyi'o// dang po ni/ slob mas maṇḍal dang yul 'khor rta glang sogs yon dbul/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob mdzad gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas bstsal// de bzhin bdag la deng stsol cig */ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rigs lnga'i dmigs pa rnams bla mas rang dang slob ma dbang rdzas gsum gar dmigs la bsgom/ slob mas rang kho nar dmigs la bsgom pa yin no// chu dbang ni/ khaṇḍa ro hes bsangs/ shū n+ya tās stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ slob dpon/ slob ma/ bum chu rnams hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i zhe sdang rdo rje nag po/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum padma'i dra ba can dud kha gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud cing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis ye shes pa dang dbang gi lha spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa dam tshig pa la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lhar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ yum rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams dbang rdzas lhar gsal ba la thim/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dbang rdzas lhar gsal ba yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba chen po'i byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin du zhu ba bum pa'i chur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bde bar gshegs pa dang gshegs ma/ sems dpa' dang sems ma/ khro bo khro mo'i rang bzhin sgo mtshams ma dang bcas pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ oṃ rū pa badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ shapad badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gandhe badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ra sa badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sparshe badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badzri huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mchod/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob mdzad gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes slob dpon gyis gsol ba btab pas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor pa rnams spyan drangs pa'i dbang gi lha gtso bo la sogs pa rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ dpa' bo byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces sogs snyan pa'i gdangs kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' bo rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rol mo'i bde chen po// mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde chen po// dgyes chen gsol ba'i bde chen po// gsol mdzad bde ba chen po ste// a la la la la la hoḥ zhes sogs rdo rje'i glu len/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod cing mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod/ khro bo khro mo sgo mtshams ma'i tshogs dang bcas pas phyogs mtshams srung zhing bgegs skrod/ bde bar gshegs ma yum bzhi phag mo dang bcas pas gdugs dang*| rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ bla bre thogs shing rol mo'i sgra sgrog /glu gar mdzad cing me tog dang gur gum la sogs pa'i char 'bebs bzhin pas byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa kha rgyan dang bcas pa bsnams nas khrus gsol zhing dbang bskur bar bsam/ bum pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje'i gsang ba gsum byung ba// sangs rgyas kun gyis sbyin par bya// oṃ trāṃ tsakra bī ra st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/

zhes bum pa mgor bzhag bum chu 'thung du gzhug /mthar/ oṃ badzrod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ su ra te st+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes bsgyings pa dang bcas brjod/ de ltar dbang bskur bas bde ba chen po dang snyoms par zhugs par bsam/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis lus gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /chu lhag ma las rigs kyi bdag po zhe sdang rdo rjes dbu brgyan/ nang gi dbang bskur ba'i phyir spyan drangs pa'i dbang lha rnams zhe sdang rdo rje'i rnam pa slob ma'i lus la bcug pas zhe sdang rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ des ni ma rig pa'i dri ma 'khrud nus pa nyid du bsgrub pa'i phyir chu'i dbang ngo*// zhes brda sprad/ de ltar na dbang lnga las mi bskyod pa chu'i dbang bskur ba thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs/ rnam shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon bzhag /rigs 'di la brten pa'i dngos grub dang phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes dag pa brjod/ dbu rgyan gyi dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ slob dpon dang*/ slob ma/ dbu rgyan rnams aṃ dang rin po che las skyes pa'i rdo rje nyi ma ser po/ rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum gsod byed ma nag mo gri thod sogs sngar ltar la/ rang bzhin du zhu ba las slob ma'i rigs bdag gang yin dbus su byas pa'i rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi nas/ char 'bebs bzhin pas rin po che'i dbu rgyan bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsam/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste// rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro ba// rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā a bhi ṣiñtsa/

zhes dang*/ rgyas par na lha lnga ka'i sngags brjod cing dbang bskur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi phreng ba'i sngags lan bdun brjod pas phreng ba mgor bcing*| mthar/ oṃ āḥbadzra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ su ra te st+waṃ a haṃ/ zhes brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas zhes pa nas/ rang bzhin du gyur par bsam/ zhes pa'i bar chu dbang ltar la/ khyad par ni/ zhe sdang rdo rje zhes pa'i mal du/ rdo rje nyi ma zhes bsgyur/ mchod nas/ des de bzhin gshegs pas rigs bdag mdzad pa'i sgo nas rgyas 'debs kyi 'du bya ba bskyed pa dang*| gtsug tor bskyed par nus pa nyid kyi ched du cod pan gyi dbang ngo*// nyon mongs pa la sogs pa'i dgra rtsad nas gzhom phyir phreng ba ste/ dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcing ba ni cod pan gyi dbang gi yan lag go// zhes dang*/ de ltar na dbang lnga las rin 'byung dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma dag /tshor ba'i phung po gnas 'gyur/ mnyam nyid ye shes mngon du byas/ rin 'byung gi sa bon bzhag /rigs 'di la brten pa'i dngos grub dang phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so| |zhes dag pa brjod/ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ slob dpon dang*/ slob ma/ rdo rje rnams hrīḥdang padma las skyes pa'i padma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum 'gugs byed ma dmar mo gri thod sogs sngar bzhin la/ zhu ba las rdo rjer gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi nas| char 'bebs bzhin pas rdo rje bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsam/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi// dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// he ru ka dpal la sogs kyis// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro// 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zung*// oṃ āḥbadzra a bhi ṣiñtsa/

zhes snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing lag g.yas su sbyin/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sogs nas/ rang bzhin du gyur par bsam pa'i bar gong ltar la/ rdo rje nyi ma'i gnas su/ padma gar gyi dbang phyug ces bsgyur| mchod nas/ des de bzhin nyid dang dbyer med pa'i ye shes skye ba'i nus ldan du bsgrubs pas rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// zhes dang*/ de ltar dbang lnga las 'od dpag med rdo rje'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi dri ma dag /'du shes kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ sor rtog ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon bzhag /rigs 'di la brten pa'i dngos grub dang phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes dag pa brjod/ dril bu'i dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ slob dpon dang*/ slob ma/ dril bu rnams hoḥdang ral gri las skyes pa'i rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu/ ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum gar gyi dbang phyug ma sngo bsangs gri thod sogs sngar ltar la/ zhu ba las dril bur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi nas/ char 'bebs bzhin pas dril bu bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsam/ sangs rgyas kun gyi dril bu yi// dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur// sangs rgyas nyid du rab bsgrub phyir// he ru ka dpal la sogs kyis// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro// 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid// rab tu grub phyir dril bu zung*// zhes dril bu mgor bzhag lag g.yon du gtad nas/ rdor dril thogs te 'khyud tshul byed du bcug la/ 'khor lo gsum bdag dpa' bo yi// lag tu rdo rje dril bu 'dzin| |rang bzhin gyis mdzes dga' ba ni// phyag rgya chen por byin gyis rlobs// oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣṭha bī ra sa ma ya st+waṃ/

zhes brjod/ slob mas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa aḥ.aḥ.aḥ bcom ldan bzung ngo bdag la ni// yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzod// ces brjod/ ji ltar bltams pas chu dbang bskur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas sogs nas/ rang bzhin du gyur par bsam pa'i bar gong ltar la/ padma gar dbang gi gnas su/ rdo rje rgyal po bcug /mchod nas/ des ni stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i ye shes chos 'byung mtshon par byed pa'i dril bu sgra dang bcas pas dbang bskur bas de'i dbang dang*/ ye shes de nyid chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong dang ye shes bla na med pa thams cad 'byung ba'i bdag po yin pas na ming gzhan bdag po'i dbang zhes kyang bya'o// zhes dang*/ de ltar dbang lnga las don grub dril bu'i dbang thob/ nyon mong pa phrag dog gi dri ma dag /'du byed kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ bya grub ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon bzhag /rigs 'di la brten pa'i dngos grub dang phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes dag pa brjod/ ming dbang ni/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ slob dpon dang*/ slob ma/ rdor dril buṃ dang 'khor lo las sgyu 'phrul rdo rje dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa la| yum ltung byed ma ser mo gri thod sogs sngar ltar la/ zhu ba las rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/ slar yang slob dpon gyi nas/ char 'bebs bzhin pas rdor dril mnyam por spyi bor bzung nas ming gi dbang bskur bar bsam/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab zhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan par// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// zhes rdor dril mgor bzhag |oṃ badzra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes me tog gang phog de'i rigs kyi ming sbyin te/

rnam snang gi rigs la gti mug rdo rje/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje sogs/ mi bskyod par zhe sdang rdo rje/ thugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ rin 'byung la nga rgyal rdo rje/ dga' ba'i rdo rje sogs/ 'od dpag med la 'dod chags rdo rje/ dbang gi rdo rje sogs/ don grub la phrag dog rdo rje/ don yod rdo rje sogs/ rdor sems kyi rigs la dang po'i rdo rje/ bde chen rdo rje sogs/ bud med rnam snang gi rigs la gti mug dga' ma sogs/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs la zhe sdang dga' ma sogs/ rin 'byung gi rigs la rin chen sgrol ma sogs/ 'od dpag med rigs la 'dod chags dga' ma sogs/ don grub kyi rigs la phrag dog dga' ma sogs/ rdor sems kyi rigs la rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs te ming gzhan yang dkyil chog rgyas pa rnams nas gsungs pa ltar sbyin/ ji ltar bltams pas chu dbang bskur/ de ltar dbang bskur bas rang bzhin du gyur par bsam pa'i bar sngar ltar la/ rdo rje rgyal po'i gnas su/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje zhes bcug /mchod nas/ des ni ma 'ongs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa'i go 'phang gi ming du 'os pa'i sa bon dgod pa'i don du ming gi dbang ngo*// zhes dang*/ de ltar dbang lnga las rnam snang ming gi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa gti mug gi dri ma dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ me long ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam snang gi sa bon bzhag /rigs 'di la brten pa'i dngos grub dang phrin las thams cad bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes dag pa brjod| rdor dril so so'i dbang la ni rtse dgu kho na dgos par gsungs la/ ming dbang la gang rung las gsal cha med do// sngags kyi dbang ni/ slob dpon gyis yi ge nyer gnyis pa brgya phrag sogs bzlas nas/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes lha la gsol ba btab/ slob mas/ sngags kyi dbang bskur ye shes che// dngos grub ster ba bdag la stsol// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

slob dpon gyi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mtha' skor du gnas pa'i sngags phreng snying ga nas phyung zhal nas thon pa slob ma'i rna ba g.yas pa'am khar zhugs snying gar zhugs par bsam/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// snying po yi ni yi ge mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa ni// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// zhes brjod cing*/ spro na/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags gnyis dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags rnams rjes zlos gsum gsum bya/ bsdu na yab yum gyi snying po gnyis rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod/ de ltar sngags kyi dbang bskur ba thob pas/ snying po sogs bzla ba la dbang zhing dpal he ru ka'i gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub ma lus pa thob pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes don bshad/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ pad zla'i gdan la slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ rdor dril 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs skyil krung gis bzhugs par bskyed/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dha ra yā mi hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje rtse lnga pa lag tu gtad la/ des kyang smin mtshams su lan gsum gsor zhing snying gar bzung ngo*// des ni ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin gyi byang chub kyi sems nang gi rdo rje dang nam du yang mi 'bral ba'i ched du rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa'o// de ltar dbang lnga po thob pas spang bya ma rig pa sogs lnga spangs/ rig pa ye shes lnga thob pas rig pa'i dbang zhes bya'o// 'di rnams thob pas bya spyod kyi rgyud nyan 'chad dang*/

sngags bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// zhes don bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar slob ma'i dbang thob nas rgyud rnams thos shing man ngag thob la/ slob dpon gyi las rnams shes shing rgyud gzhan la ston nus pa'i slob mas/ slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i phyir yon dang maṇḍal phul nas/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol// 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa// de ni deng 'dir mdzad du gsol// rang dang gzhan don nus gyur pa'i// rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang*// thugs rje'i gter kye bdag la stsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ shar lho dbang stegs dbus rdo rje g.yas g.yon seng ges bteg pa'i steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar sna tshogs padma 'dab brgyad kyi gdan la/ slob ma phyag rgya lngas spras/ lag tu kha ṭwāṃ ga gtad la gzhag /steng du bla bre/ g.yas g.yon du lha mos bzung ba'i gdugs/ rgyal mtshan/ ba dan sogs bsgrengs/ ḍā ma ru thogs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mos bskor/ mdun du mchod rdzas bkram pa la dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed pa de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi| |he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dha ra yā mi badzra satwa hīḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ lag g.yas su gtad nas thugs rdo rje'i dam tshig 'dzin du gzhug cing*/ de nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog gi dang po'i skyes bu'o// oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes slob mas kyang rjes zlos bya/

dril bu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las aḥlas skyes pa'i yum rdo rje snyems mar gsal ba de zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur bltas la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces lag pa g.yon du gtad la/ gsung dril bu'i dam tshig 'dzin du bcug cing*/ slob mas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe ra ṇa/ pra ra ṇa/ saṃ pra ra ṇi/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā nā da swa bhā we/ badzra dha ra hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod de dkrol/ slar yang*/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag |ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badzra ghaṇṭa aḥ zhes slob mas rjes zlos bya/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi 'jigs dus kyi gdan la hūm̐ dang rdo rje las dpal he ru ka sku mdog nag po/ zhal gcig pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bsgyings pa'i pang du yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan par gyur/ slob dpon gyis 'bar ba'i rgyas/ pheṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur pa de'i snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo'i dbus su oṃ dkar pos mtshan par gyur pa bsgom pa ni sku phyag rgya'i dam tshig go// slob dpon gyi dbang dngos ni/ slob dpon gyis/ yid kyi lus ni brtan byed pa// dam tshig phyag rgyar grags pa yi// sku ni nye bar gnas kyis la// phyag rgya rtag tu brtan par gyis// ye shes phyag rgyar byin brlabs nas// 'dod pa thams cad longs spyad de// dngos grub thams cad sgrub par gyis// zhes brjod pas|

dam tshig rang gi 'dod lha'i lus nang gi phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs nas rdo rje 'dzin pas yid rig ye shes kyi phyag rgya la 'khyud par bsam zhing 'khyud tshul byed du bcug /shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang yang 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// yid kyis rig ma la 'khyud pa las nyams su myong ba'i bde stong gnyis su med pa rang rig pa ste/ reg bde gang yin pa de ni slob dpon gyi dbang ngam/ bum dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ yid stong nyid snying rje gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyi thugs rdo rjer sgrub pa'i ched du rdo rje'i dam tshig /ngag chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong ston pa'i bdag nyid sangs rgyas kyi gsung rdo rjer sgrub pa'i ched du sgra dang bcas pa'i dril bu'i dam tshig /lus thabs shes zung 'jug gi ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi sku rdo rjer brtan par sgrub pa'i ched du phyag rgya'i dam tshig go// de yang phyag rgya'i dam tshig kho na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dbang du gsungs te/ gur las/ drug pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pas so// zhes brjod/ slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs| |de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs ni bsdu bar gyis// zhes brjod/ bum chu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i mi bskyod pa yab yum du gyur pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med thim/ dbang lhas dbang bskur dri ma dag /chu lhag ma las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha mi bskyod par thim zhing mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu ba bum chur gyur/

slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa dbang lha gdan gsum tshang ba'i rnam par spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar bstsal// de ltar 'di la'ang bstsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ sems ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod/ yum rnams kyis byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsam/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis// skye bas thob pa'i dbang bskur ba// ji ltar de bzhin bdag gis te// dag pa lha yi chu dbang bskur// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brtan phyir chu dbang bskur| de ltar bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang lha rnams ye shes sems dpa'i ngo bor slob ma'i lus la thim pas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi rang bzhin du brtan par gyur par bsam/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swā hā/ zhes me tog 'thor/ de nas/ oṃ badzra puṣpaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ dag pa brjod pa ni/ thams cad dngos po gcig nyid du// sprul sku'i mdzad pa rdzogs gyur pa// dur khrod yin te lus su dag /ye shes snang bas kun khyab cing*// bdud bcom 'od dang rdo rje ldan// mi mnyam med pas zur bzhi pa// 'phags pa'i bden pa dngos bzhi nyid// dran gnas dbang po sgo bzhi ste// bsam gnas rnams kyi rta babs nyid// tshon sna lnga po sangs rgyas te// dge ba'i spyod pa shīrṣa ka// dra tshogs byang chub yan lag bdun// ba dan dril bu gsung rab sgra// ting nge 'dzin gyi kha khyer te// gzungs ni 'dod pa'i lha mo'o| |padma 'dam gyis ma gos te// gcod byed 'khor lo rnams yin no// rnam thar brgyad kyi ka ba ste// sna tshogs chos 'khor rgyal po'i gnas// 'khor lo gdugs kyis rnam par mdzes| |chos kyi dbyings su ro gcig phyir// rtse mo rdo rjes brgyan pa nyid// ces dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid dang*/

yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin thabs snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin dngos po kun gyi bdag nyid can ni dpal he ru ka rdo rje'o// shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin lhan skyes ye shes kyi ngo bo zag med bde ba'i rang bzhin 'khor 'das thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa ni rdo rje phag mo'o// chos thams cad thabs shes zung 'jug lhan cig skyes pa du ma ro gcig pa'i phyir yab yum snyoms par 'jug pa/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dga' ba'i rang bzhin chu khams dag pa mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa mchog dga'i rang bzhin rlung khams dag pa rab mdzes ma/ chos rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa dga' bral gyi rang bzhin me khams dag pa dum skyes ma/ sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa lhan skyes kyi rang bzhin sa khams dag pa gzugs can ma/ phung sogs dag cing de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i ngo bo bum pa dang thod pa bzhi'o// gzhan yang rang gi lus ni gzhal yas khang*/ phung po lnga rnam par dag pa rigs lnga/ 'byung ba lnga dag pa yum lnga/ mig sogs nang gi skye mched dag pa sems dpa'/ gzugs sogs nang gi skye mched dag pa sems ma/ tshigs rtsa dang nyon mongs pa'i tshogs dag pa khro bo dang khro mo ste/ lus ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor du gdod nas dag pa yin la/ de yang mdor na/ gtso bo gcig gi zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes rten brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rol par shar ba yin la dag pa'i snod bcud ltar rten brten par don gzhan dang*/ lha rnams rgyud tha dad pa dang*/ phyi nang mchog dman sogs gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa mtha' dag spangs te/ chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang du bzhag go// de thams cad kyang don rang gi sems nyid las ma 'das te/ bshad rgyud thams cad gsang ba las/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa| |yid ni dkyil 'khor dam pa yin// zhes sogs gsungs pas go bar byos shig

/des khyod kyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pa yin pas dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing sgrub pa dang*/ 'jug cing dbang bskur ba dang*/ rab gnas dang*/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi las dang bya ba'i rim pa 'khor dang bcas pa la dbang ba yin no// de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid la sogs pa shes pa dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa de kho na nyid bzhin du bsgrub par bya ba la skal pa ste nus pa dang ldan pa yin la/ de yang rdo rje 'chang gi bcas pa las 'da' bar bya bar ma yin pa ni dam tshig dang*/ bya rgyu mi byed pa dang*/ mi byed rgyu byed pa/ 'gog pa'i ngo bo ni sdom pa yin pas de nyid nges pa'i sgo nas tshul bzhin du sgrub par byos shig /ces bsgo| spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ kha ṭwāṃ ga /ḍā ma ru/ thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba/ tshangs skud rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bcom ldan 'das yab yum skad cig gis gsal ba zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas so so'i rnam par bltas la/ he ru ka yi phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// kha ṭwāṃ cang te'u dung chen dang*// dpa' bo'i mchod phyir thogs bcas pa// byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis// zhes brjod cing lag g.yas su ḍā ru/ g.yon du thod pa/ phrag par tshangs skud/ gru mor kha ṭwāṃ ga dril bu 'phyang ba byin la/ kha ṭwāṃ ga lha yi sku bde ba chen po/ ḍā ma ru shes rab stong pa nyid/ thod pa de gnyis 'dus pa'i bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs skud rnam par mi rtog pa'i don yin no// zhes go ba bskyed/ des ni kha ṭwāṃ gas yab/ cang te'u yum/ thod pas bzla bya'i sngags/ tshangs skud mi rtog pa'i ye shes mtshon pas don du lha yab yum sgom zhing sngags bzla/ mi rtog pa la mnyam par 'jog pa la sbyor ba'i don yin no// de nas rgyan lnga 'dzin pa spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ rgyan lnga bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'khor lo zhe sdang rdo rje nag po g.yas rdo rje/
