rna cha padma gar dbang dmar po g.yas padma/ mgul rgyan rdo rje nyi ma ser po g.yas rin po che/ gdu bu sku rdo rje dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ ska rags rdo rje rgyal po ljang gu g.yas ral gri/ g.yon rnams de dag gis mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa de yongs su gyur pa las rgyan so sor bltas la/ oṃ badzra dhṛka ྄phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum bzlas la/ he ru ka yi phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// 'khor lo mi bskyod pa yi gzugs| |byin pa dpa' bos blang bar gyis// zhes spyi bor sbyin/ de bzhin du/ oṃ ā ro lika phaṭ swā hā/ dang*/ rkang pa gsum par/ rna rgyan gnyis ni gsung rdo rje// zhes rna ba gnyis la/ oṃ ratna dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ dang*/ mgul gyi phreng ba rin chen 'byung*// zhes mgul par/ oṃ dzi na dzika phaṭ swā hā/ lag gdub rtag pa'i bdag nyid do// zhes rkang lag /oṃ pradzñā dhṛka phaṭ swā hā/ ska rags la ni don yod grub// ces sked par sbyin/ 'di rnams bud med la sbyin na dpa' bo zhes pa dpa' mor bsgyur/ de ltar rgyan lnga 'dzin pa ni rnal 'byor ma dang lhan cig spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang ldan pa las ye shes lnga skyed pa la sbyor ba yin no// zhes brjod/ mgo bo'i do shal sogs 'dzin pa'i spyod pa ni/ lta stangs sogs kyi nus pa thob pas gzhan don du dpa' bo'i spyod pa'i brtul zhugs yin yang*/ deng sang de lta bu'i drod thob pa dkon pas 'dir ma bris/ gal te sbyin dgos byung na phreng ba sogs su yod pa ltar sbyin no// bum dbang gi mtha' rten rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ sgeg sogs brgyad/ mig thur/ me long*/ dril bu/ mda' gzhu/ yang me long rnams sbyin par spro na dkyil chog gzhan ltar sbyin no// de nas/ zhi rgyas dbang dang 'gugs pa dang*// bskrad pa dang ni bsad pa sogs// phan dang tshar gcod byed pa yi// las rnams khyod kyis sgrub par gyis// zhes phrin las sgrub pa'i rjes gnang sbyin/

ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*// rkang mgyogs bcud len mkha' la 'gro// mi snang sgrub pa la sogs pa// ci dga' bar ni sgrub par gyis// zhes dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang sbyin/ lus dang srog la ltos med par// dam tshig sdom pa kun bsrungs te// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// don ldan rtag tu bzla bar bya// zhes dam tshig sdom pa'i rjes gnang sbyin/ dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba re re mngon bya ba// 'khor lo gnyis med tshul gnas pa// tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod// ces mchod pa'i rjes gnang sbyin/ de nas 'khor lo/ dung*/ dril bu/ po ti rnams kyi rjes gnang yang spro na bya/ de nas/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang ba gyis// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga rnams// skye bo yongs la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan thogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang*// khyed la rtag tu bsrungs bar mdzad// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// sngags dang rgyud ni 'dzin gyur pas| |sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs// sems can kun la rjes brtse bas// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// nan tan bskyed de bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor// zhes chos 'chad pa'i rjes gnang sbyin/ 'dir rigs lnga so so'i chos 'chad pa'i rjes gnang spro na bya/ des ni cho ga ji lta ba bzhin dngos grub bsgrubs nas sems can gyi don bya yi/ de yang zang zing sogs kyi min pas chos ston pa kho na yang dag pa yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang rdo rje theg pa'i chos ston pa nyid mchog dang*/ rab dang*/

phul dang*/ rtse mor gyur pa yin pas/ sems can thams cad gang 'dul gyi theg pa'i chos ston la mthar thug rdo rje theg pa 'ba' zhig la sbyor zhig ces pa'i don no// zhes brjod/ des ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ gtso bor lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i dri ma 'khrud/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ thun mong ba'i dngos grub bsgrub pa la dbang*/ rtsa ba'i dam tshig bcu bzhi/ yan lag brgyad de dam tshig nyer gnyis bsrung*/ sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la 'jog /'bras bu sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ gtang rag gi maṇḍal dbul/ gnyis pa ni/ slob mas mtshal dang sindhu ra sogs dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇḍal dang*/ gser sogs rin po che dang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ma rgyan gyis spras pa phul nas/ skyob pa skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs// 'khor lo sdom pa bdag skyob mdzod// rgyu med par ni thugs rje can// mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig |bdag nyid chen po khyod ji ltar// khyab bdag bdag kyang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs su ni// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings/ slob dpon rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom pa rdor dril 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan cing g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa/ slob mas phul ba'i rig ma skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi snying gar oṃ ha nas/ dud kha rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ yab yum gnyis kyi dpral bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ nas/ nag pos mtshan pa'i bar dang*/ yab kyi gsang ba hūm̐ las rdo rje nas/ hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs ltar gsal btab/ yab yum tsumba na sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/

zhes par snyoms par 'jug pa dang lhan cig /rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis rnam snang la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ spyan ma sogs rang rigs kyi yum dang snyoms par 'jug bzhin pa bkug /bdag nyid rnam snang gi sgo nas bcug pas 'dod chags chen pos zhu ba a wa dhū ti nas 'gro bar bsam zhing*/ snyoms 'jug gis byang sems bab pa rdo rje nor bur lhan skyes brtan par byas pa mtheb srin gyis btsir nas padmar lhung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zhu ba las byung ba'i khu ba rang gi byang sems dbyer med par mos nas/ slob ma padma gar gyi dbang phyug tu gsal ba'i mgo bo dang*/ dpral ba/ mig gnyis/ kha dang mgrin pa/ snying ga ste/ gnas bdun du/ yab kyi phreng sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying bzla bzhin pas thig le bya zhing*/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas la// mchod chen dbang bskur bstsal ba bzhin// bzang po byang chub sems kyis ni| |de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod/ slar yang*/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// de bzhin du ni byang chub sems// mdzes pas bu khyod dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod/ slob ma rgyud dag pa rab kyis lces mkha' gsang nas blang*/ 'bring la slob dpon gyis mtheb srin gyis blangs la khar sbyin/ tha ma la bdud rtsi dang sbyar ba sbyin/ des kyang*/ a hoḥm hā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod cing btung*/ de bzhin du shes rab mas kyang gcer bur langs te/ rang gi padmar gnas pa'i byang sems slob ma'i khar dbab cing*/ 'di de dpa' bo lha mo rnams// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga ldan pa'i ro rtogs byed// bde ba de dag myang bar gyis// oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī badzra warṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces byin pa slob mas sngar ltar btung*| mgrin par rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'dus pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug tu byang sems dkar dmar gyis gang*/

de nas brgyud de lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ gsal stong bde bas brgyan pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes par bsam/ oṃ badzra nai tra sogs kyis mig dar bsal/ slob ma bha ga'i dkyil 'khor la ltar bcug la/ bha ga dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rnam pa nā da las skye'o// zhes de kho na nyid bstan/ de yang phyag rgya'i bha ga la bltas pas byang sems g.yos pa mchog dga'i bde ba stong nyid dang gnyis su med pa rang rig pa ni gsang dbang ste/ gnas gsang ba bha ga la blta ba dang*| thabs shes kun rdzob byang sems gsang ba'i rdzas kyis dbang bskur bas kyang gsang ba zhes bya la/ de'i tshe rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags nas/ bde stong zung 'jug 'bar 'dzag gi rkyen gyis zhu bde lhan skyes thig le gsum gyi ye shes mngon du byas pa ni gsang dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ gsang dbang gi mtha' rten lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon shāka thub kyi nga rgyal nam/ gyon pa'i grwa g.yon pas bzung*/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid dang ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye zhes bos nas/ gsang mtshan nas brjod la/ zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa grub pas sa gsum gyi bdag por 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ gang la ngas tshig 'dis lung bstan pa 'di la/ sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par 'gyur te/ de ni phyag rgya dang sngags 'di'i mthu yin no// de bas khyed rnams dad pa rab tu skyed cig /ces brjod/ de'i don ni/ khams gsum dang dbyer med pa'i chos nyid rtogs par nus pa khyod yin no zhes gzengs stod pa'i don/ ma 'ongs par 'tshang rgya 'gyur du lung ston pa'ang yin no// zhes don bshad/ de ltar gsang ba bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mthong*/

gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gtso bor ngag gi dri ma dag /lam bdag byin brlab dang*/ tsaṇḍa lī dang*/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i rim pa la sogs pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa bsten/ longs sku 'grub pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la 'jog /'bras bu gsung rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ gtang rag dbul/ gsum pa ni/ nor bu rin po che bai ḍūrya la sogs pa'i yon dang maṇḍal dbul| phyag byas nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// mi phyed phyag rgya rab tu bsgrubs// rdo rje rnal 'byor las byung ba// bdag nyid chen po khyod bzhin du| |gtso bos bdag kyang mdzad du gsol// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma dang rig ma gnyis ka'i gdong bcing*/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis slob ma mi bskyod pa nag po/ zhal gcig /phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan par gyur/ de'i snying gar oṃ ha nas/ phaṭa haṃ ljang gu rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slob ma mi bskyod par gsal ba la thim gnyis su med par gyur/ de'i snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin pa padma la āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ dkar pos mtshan par bsam/ slar slob mas phul ba'i rig ma de'am/ gzhan mtshan ldan gang rung lo bcu gnyis yan nyi shu man chad gzugs dang lang tshor ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dam tshig dang sdom par gnas pa'i lag g.yon slob ma'i g.yas su gtad/ slob dpon gyis spyi bo nas bzung la/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// zung zhig zung zhig sems dpa' che// bzung nas mchod pa rtag tu bya// thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min// 'gro ba gsum po dag byed pa// de bas khyod kyis 'di dang ni// 'bral ba nam yang mi bya'o// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig ma'i brtul zhugs bla na med// blun po gang gis 'di spangs na// de la mchog gi bde ba med// ces gtad/

rig ma des skra bshig gos dang bral bar byas nas/ bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro 'am// bud med rnams la gus pa dang*// bha ga'i padmor 'o byed pa// bu khyod ji ltar dga' ba smros// zhes brjod par slob mas de'i lan du/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro// khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang*// bud med rnams la rtag gus shing*// bha ga'i padmor 'o bgyid do// zhes lan btab pas lha mo mnyes nas/ gur gum la sogs pa dri bzang pos dri zhim par byas pa'i padma rab tu rgyas pa kha phye nas slob ma la bstan te/ e ma bdag gi padma 'di// bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan// ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na bdag gnas te// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// bya ba thams cad padmas byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni yang dag gnas// bhañdza mokṣa hoḥ zhes brjod de pang du byon pa'i tshe/ slob ma skad cig gis 'khor lo sdom pa dang*/ rig ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang ba na rtsa hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa/ rig ma'i g.yon gyi char song ba'i rtsa'i rtse mo hrīḥdamar po dang ldan pa mdzub mo dang lces sid ces pas bskul nas/ oṃ shī shī shī ha ha ha swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum rnams bkug /bla mas kyang gshegs pa gshegs ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ de'i lus la bcug pas ro gcig tu gyur par mos/ sbyor thabs drug po sngon du 'gro bas snyoms 'jug gi sbyor ba byas shing bskyod pa'i tshe gtum mo'i mes gtsug tor gyi haṃ yig zhu ba'i thig le dpral ba'i bar du bab pa dga' ba/ mgrin pa dang snying ga'i bar du bab pa mchog dga'/ lte ba'i bar du bab pa khyad par dga' ba/

rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo'i bar du bab cing gang nas phyir ma 'phos pa cha bcu drug pa lhan cig skyes dga' ste/ gang la thog ma dbus mtha' med// bdag med gzhan yang med pa ste// srid med mya ngan 'das pa med// 'di ni mchog tu bde chen nyid// ces gsungs pa'i don/ bsam du med pa'i shes rab shin tu phra bar lta zhing 'od gsal ba'i bde ba nyams su myong bar bya/ nus pa ji lta bas bzung la hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rlung mig sems gsum gyen du ldog pa'i sbyor bas btsan thabs su gyen du drangs pas gsang bar dga' ba/ lte ba dang snying gar mchog dga'/ dpral bar khyad dga'/ gtsug tor du lhan cig skyes dga' brtan par bsam/ ma nus na dal bus btang la padma nas lces blangs te de kho na nyid du bltas la dam tshig gi rdzas byang chub kyi sems su rung ngo*// de ltar lus thams cad bde bas khyab pa'i bde stong zung 'jug rjes chags dpe'i ye shes mngon du byas pa ni dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo yin no// zhes brjod/ de nas rig ma de mnyes nas slob ma'i mgo bor phyag g.yon pa bzhag ste/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// rmi lam bzhin du 'gro kun gyi// don ni bdag nyid kun gyis byos// zhes rjes su gnang ba bstsal bar bsam/ slob dpon gyis/ mtshan ldan bud med mthong ba dang*// g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya ste// thal sbyar nas ni gsol ba btab// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dam bsgrags/ de nas gnyis ka'i gdong g.yogs bsal/ sher dbang gi mtha' rten dbugs dbyung ba ni/ yum gyi snying po'i sngags kyis slob ma'i snying gar btab/ lag g.yas par sngags bzlas pa'i bsrung ba'i lag gdub bcing*/ gos rgyan gsar pa dang bcas par/

slob dpon nam las kyi rdo rjes gdugs thogs pa slob ma'i mgor phub bzhin pas dkyil 'khor la lan gsum g.yon du bskor/ slob mas dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo nas lus sa la phab pa'i phyag gsum byas pa'i phyag tha ma mgo ma bteg pa'i skabs der/ slob dpon gyis/ rgyud rnams 'dzin par gyur pa yi// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags// zhes slob ma dkyil 'khor pa la phul bar bsam/ de nas gdugs logs su bzhag nas/ slob ma'i snying la 'bab pa'i tshig 'di skad slob dpon gyis brjod/ da ni khyod rnams dkyil 'khor gyi// slob dpon sngags dang rgyud 'dzin par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams dag kyang dgongs par 'gyur// sems can kun la brtse don du// khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin// rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya// sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor| |mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi// dkyil 'khor mthong zhing zhugs pas na// sdig pa kun las rnam par grol/ */de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ */bde chen theg pa 'di las ni/ */ phyin chad 'chi ba khyod la med// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// srid pa mtha' 'das grub ched du// sangs rgyas rdo rje can kun gyis// de ring tshe ldan dbang bskur ro// khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che'i// bdag po nyid du khyod nges so// 'dod chags bral ba lta bu'i sdig /khams gsum na ni gzhan med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral ni// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// 'dod pa kun la spyod pa khyod// gang la'ang 'jigs med spyad par gyis// sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bza' bya// 'di las gzhan yang dam tshig bsrung*// srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing*// bud med rin chen spang mi bya// slob dpon spang bar mi bya ste// dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'// shes rab thabs kyi bsam pa yis// mi bya cung zad yod ma yin| |ma 'jigs khyod la sdig pa med// de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ji bzhin// 'di ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par gyis// 'gro ba bde ba myur bar rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyod rnams phyin par 'gyur// gzhan yang gang dag cho ga ji lta ba bzhin du dbang bskur ba la dge ba'i phyir/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sdug pa'i bu dang 'dra bar thugs dang bas yang dag par dgongs par mdzad pa 'di ni chos nyid yin no// zhes brjod| de yang dbugs dbyung gi don ni/ khyod 'dod pa la longs spyad kyang nyes pas gos pa med pa sangs rgyas nyid yin no// zhes dbugs dbyung ba ste/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba sogs kyis sangs rgyas thob par nus pa'i sa bon rgyas par bya ba la dgongs pas don de dag rtogs par byos shig /ces bshad/ des kun rdzob byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong*| shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ gtso bor yid kyi dri ma dag /nor bu 'gengs pa'i rim pa'am/ pho nya'i lam 'og sgo bde ba chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig tu phyag rgya bzhi gang rung dang mi 'bral/ chos kyi sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i skal ldan du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ gtang rag dbul/ bzhi pa ni/ sman 'bru la sogs pa'i yon bzang po dang maṇḍal dbul/ slob dpon gyi zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te/ khyod zhabs padmo'i bka' drin gyis// gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ */de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ */bdag la bka' drin rab tu stsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gdong dar bcings/ bla mas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis phyag rgya dang dbang po gnyis sprad cing snyoms par zhugs pa la brten nas myong ba snang ba thob pa'i shes pa de 'od gsal bar sgoms shig /de ni rnam par shes pa gsum rnam par dag pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i ngo bo nyid lus dang ngag dang sems med pa/ las dang skye ba las grol ba/ zla ba dang nyi ma dang me dang nor bu ltar shin tu gsal ba/ rtag tu snang ba'i mtshan nyid can/ don dam pa'i bden pa de ni mthong ba gzhan gyi yul las 'das pa ste/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi mig gis ltos shig

/de ltar gang gis kyang rang bzhin du ma mthong ba de 'od gsal ba yin no// de ltar 'od gsal ba de'i ngor rgyu 'bras gang yang med mod| 'on kyang kun rdzob tu rlung dang sems tsam las lha lnga me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal la rdzogs pa/ 'ja' tshon ltar kha dog dang bcas pa/ chu zla ltar sgro skur dang bral bar ltos shig /de ni rgyu rkyen la bltos nas skyes pas kun rdzob bo// de ltar bden pa gnyis mi phyed pa zung du 'jug pa ni byang chub kyi sems chen po ste bzhi pa'o// de'i don mdor dril ba ni/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste// phyi rol yul ni rnam spangs pa// rigs 'di bor nas de las ni// gzhan pa'i thabs kyi sangs rgyas med// rig ma'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu// brtul zhugs kun gyi bla ma'i bla// mtshan med bsam gyis mi khyab pa// 'di la rtag tu gnas par gyis// zhes pa ste/ de ni don dam stong pa 'od gsal ba// kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu lha'i sku zung du 'jug pa'i dbang bzhi pa ni/ rang nyid mdzes pa nges don gyi rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ste/ phyi rol yul gyi bud med dngos dang*/ rtog btags drang don bsam byas kyi yid rig la sogs pa thams cad spangs pa ste/ don dam pa'i rig ma 'di bor nas de las gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas mi thob pas/ brtul zhugs rnams kyi gong ma'i yang gong ma gyur pa nges don gyi rig ma'i brtul zhugs spyod cig */ces pa ste/ don du rang sems 'od gsal thabs mchog he ru ka dang stong phyogs shes rab kyi mdzes ma nges don gyi lha yab yum bsam med lhan skyes kyi snyoms 'jug la brten/ brjod med don dam gyi dga' bzhi nyams su myong bya myong byed dang bral ba'i myong ba de nyid la goms par byos shig */ces brda sprad/ tshul 'di rgyas par spro na/ dpal chen rga lo'i rang byin rlabs kyi man ngag ltar nyams su blang ba mchog yin no// mig dar bsal/

de ltar spros bral bde chen rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi ye shes mngon du byas pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no// zhes brjod/ de nas bzhi pa'i mtha' rten gzengs bstod pa ni/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs shing mthong*/ dbang bskur ba thob pa tsam gyis srid pa shin tu dag pa'i byang chub chen por 'gyur ro// de'i don ni khyod dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs mthong gi phan yon gyis sdig pa thams cad skad cig gis grol nas bde ba mchog thob cing*/ srid zhi thams cad las 'das pa'i myang 'das mngon du byed ces yid dga' skyed pa'i don yin no// de yang bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud kyi le'u gcig par/ mi mchog gang zhig kun spyod pa| |sdig pa thams cad rnam dag bdag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa thob cing*// skye dang skye bar bde gshegs kyi// rigs skye rgyal po chos ldan 'gyur// ji ltar sngon bsags sdig pa yi| |mtshan nyid thams cad dman pa ste// gang zhig 'di ni rtag sgom pa// sa la 'dod pa kun dbang phyug /dper na mar gyis bkang ba'i snod// me yi dbus su bzhag na ni/ */ mar sar steng du zhu 'gyur zhing*// snod kyi dri ma 'jig par 'gyur// de bzhin shrī he ru ka'i// mtshan gyis sdig pa 'jig par 'gyur// bsam gtan bsam pa tsam gyis sam// klog cing kha ton bris pa yis// mtho ris longs spyod thob 'gyur ba'am// yang na 'khor los sgyur ba thob// rnal 'byor pa rnams 'pho tshe dpal// khrag 'thung sogs dpa' rnal 'byor ma// me tog sna tshogs lag na thogs// rgyal mtshan ba dan sna tshogs dang*// rol mo'i sgra ni sna tshogs dang*// glu yi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis// mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid par byed// 'chi ba zhes ni rnam rtog yin// de 'dra'i dpal chen rnal 'byor ma// sa steng na ni rnyed par dka'// zhes 'khor lo sdom pa'i mtshan tsam mthong thos dang*/

rgyud bris bklags kha ton byas pas kyang mtho ris sogs thob par bshad na mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por zhugs shing dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pas ni nges par gdon mi za bar srid pa tha mar byed par nges so// zhes dga' ba bsgom pa'o// des don dam byang sems kyi dkyil 'khor chen po mthong*/ dbang bzhi pa tshig gi sgo nas thob/ lus ngag yid sgrib mtha' dag dang ye shes kyi dri ma gzung 'dzin phra ba tshun dag /lam phyag rgya chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ dam tshig ni/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya// gzhan gyi bud med rnams spyad nas// ma byin par yang khyod kyis longs// thams cad la yang rdzun tshig smros// zhes dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bzhi bsrung*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'am bde ba chen po'i sku'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /'bras bu ye shes rdo rje mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa dang ldan par byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ slob mas gus pa dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la g.yon tu bskor ba bya zhing*/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la phyag byas te yon dang khyad par bdag nyid 'bul te/ deng nas brtsams te bran du bdag /khyod la bdag ni 'bul ba lags// zhes lus dbul| slar/ sngar khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa rnams srung sems kyis/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// lan gsum brjod/ gtang rag gi phyag dang maṇḍal dbul lo| |de nas lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir grub na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ ma grub na he ru ka'i yig brgya mang du bzla/ dpon slob lhan cig dkyil 'khor la mchod pa rgyas par dbul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo 'og nas 'byung ba ltar byas te/ slob ma la khyod kyis 'jug pa 'di su la'ang smra bar mi bya'o// zhes bsgo/ phyi rol lam nang du phyogs skyong la gtor ma sbyin dkyil 'khor la phyag bya'o// tshogs 'khor ni/

kha na ma tho ba'i skyon dang bral ba'i tshogs rdzas khu ba dang gong bu ji snyed 'byor ba gcan gzan gyi pags pa'i gdan la khu ba g.yon/ gong bu g.yas su bshams/ lag g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi blangs te g.yon du gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod cing lag gnyis mnye/ de nas g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga la tshom bu re re dang lag mthil dbus su gcig mthar lnga bkod de bdud rtsi'i thig le bya/ lag pa bsangs sbyangs/ lag mthil du padma dmar po'am lte bar oṃ baṃ las rdo rje phag mo/ mdun nas g.yon du haṃ yoṃ las gshin rje ma/ hrīṃ moṃ las rmongs byed ma/ hriṃ hrīṃ las skyod byed ma/ huṃ hūm̐ las skrag byed ma/ phaṭa phaṭa las gtum mo/ mthe bong la oṃ ha las rdor sems/ mdzub mo la na ma hi las rnam snang*/ gung mo la swā hā hu las padma gar dbang*/ srin lag la bau ṣaṭa he las he ru kaḥ mthe'u chung la huṃ hūm̐ hoḥlas rdo rje nyi ma/ sen mo rnams la phaṭa haṃ las rta mchog /rdor sems dang rmongs byed ma zla ba/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ lag pa'i rgyab kyi bol du mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar snang ba/ lag pa'i sa khams ltung byed ma/ chu khams gsod byed ma/ me khams 'gugs byed ma/ rlung khams gar dbang ma/ nam mkha'i khams padma'i dra ba can rnams su gyur/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod thigs 'bul zhing*/ oṃ baṃ/ haṃ yoṃ/ hrīṃ moṃ/ hriṃ hrīṃ/ huṃ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ha/ na ma hi/ swā hā hu/ bau ṣaṭa he/ huṃ hūm̐ hoḥ phaṭa haṃ/ oṃ shrī badzra he he ru ru kaṃ huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la samba raṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ḍā ki nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ lā me huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ khaṇḍa ro he huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ rū pi ṇī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces dang*/ rkang brgyad gnyis brjod la mchod/ slar yang*/

khu ba dang gong bu'i rdzas kyang gong ltar so so'i sngags kyis 'bul/ nyer spyod lnga dang rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ yig brgyas lhag chad bskang*/ tshogs 'khor byin gyis rlob pa'i don du yid kyis gsol ba btab/ lag pa'i lha la phul ba'i rdzas rnams kyi phyed snod gzhan du bzhag ste dben par sba/ phyed tshogs rdzas la bsre/ lag gnyis thal sbyar snying mgrin dpral bar reg cing*/ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ/ lag pa'i lha rnams rang la thim par gyur par mos/ lag pa la 'gos pa'i rdzas rnams lag pa phan tshun mnyes nas gdong dang yan lag la byug na bsrung ba'i mchog go// de nas tshogs la bdud rtsi 'thor zhing*/ sgrub thabs kyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'i phud dkyil 'khor du 'bul zhing*/ hūm̐ */ spyi bo bde chen pho brang nas// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// phyogs bcu dag pa'i pho brang nas// brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa'i tshogs| |'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas// bcom ldan khrag 'thung bde ba'i mchog /phyi nang gzhan gsum gnas yul nas// dpa' bo dang ni dpa' mo'i tshogs// dur khrod rngam 'jigs pho brang nas// bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// rnal 'byor gdung bas spyan 'dren gyi// thugs brtser dgongs nas myur gshegs la// dngos grub rnam gnyis bstsal du gsol| |kye/ tshogs khang pho brang gzhal yas 'di// o rgyan gnas su byin gyis rlobs// tshogs mgron dpa' bo dpa' mo ste// snod rnams mtshan ldan ka pā la// bcud ni ye shes bdud rtsi che// gong bu sha zan g.yos sbyar ba// thabs kyi bza' ba sna tshogs dang*// 'bras rgun bu ram 'bru bcud kyi// myos byed shes rab ma da na// rigs lnga yab yum ngo bo nyid// 'chi med bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brjod pa 'bru gsum 'od zer gyis// zhe sdang 'dod chags gti mug las// gyur pa'i tshogs rdzas dkar dmar mthing*// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs// spyad pas rdo rje gsum gyi dngos// sku gsum ye shes lnga rtogs byed// rtog bral bdud rtsi'i tshogs 'khor 'di// lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir| |rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa'i tshogs// 'khor lo sdom pa yum dang bcas// gnas yul dpa' bo dpa' mo dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// mchod 'os kun la 'bul lags kyi// a la la te dgyes par rol// bdag cag 'dir 'dus thams cad kyi// sgo gsum phung khams skye mched la// byin gyis brlab par mdzad nas kyang*// sku gsum go 'phang thob mdzad gsol// de nyid ma thob bar du yang*// phyi nang bar gcod mi 'byung zhing*// bsam don 'bad med 'grub pa dang*// mchog thun dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes byin gyis brlabs shing 'bul/

las kyi rdo rjes tshogs spros/ lag g.yas ma da na thogs/ g.yon ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya bstan nas/ mthong ba'i chos ni dag pa la// med do snyam pa'i rtog pa thong*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams// mnyam nyid gcig pa nyid du gsol// zhes brjod cing*/ slob dpon nas rim bzhi drangs/ len pa po rnams g.yon ba dan gsum pa'i rgya dang*/ g.yas pas tshogs blangs te/ bde gshegs chos la rin thang med// 'dod sogs dri ma dang bral zhing*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// de nyid la ni gus pas 'dud// ces brjod/ lus la gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha rnams mchod par mos pas/ lag g.yon pas thog mar blangs shing longs spyad/ rnam lnga 'dod kor dang bcas rdo rje'i glu blang ba ni/ khro bo'i bde ba dgyes pa yi// bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba'i// bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis// rab tu rmongs pas brtan par byed// bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol// rnal 'byor ma mchog padma'i bde// a la la la la la hoḥ dgyes pa rnams kyi bde ba'i mchog /rnal 'byor ma tshogs mchod par mdzod// a ī ā ā ra li hoḥ rab dgyes mgon po dgyes bzhugs mdzod// mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba gsol// dgyes pa'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod| |zhi ba'i gar gyis gar mdzad pa// bdag la bde chen bde ba stsol// thar pa'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod// a la la la la la hoḥ bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur// bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol// bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas// chags pa'i dngos pos khyod ma bsgyur// bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod// padma rgyas pa'i ro nyid kyis// bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod// 'di yis mgon po bskul nas ni// dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub// snyan cing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni// dpyid kyi rgyal mo glu blangs pas// dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yis// gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin// zhes glu blang*/

bag med pa'i spyod pa dang bral bas longs spyod do// de ma khad du lhag ma rnams bsdus pa slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag par/ slob dpon gyi lag gnyis mthe bong dang mdzub mo so sor rtse sprad/ lhag ma rnams brkyangs pa kha'i thad du bzhag pa'i dbus nas ma da na'i kha phru btab/ oṃ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐ */ dpal chen bka' nyan lhag ma'i bdag /gnas zhing sngags dang las skyes pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro dang*// phyogs skyong zhing skyong lha dang klu// gnod sbyin srin po yi dwags gdon// ging dang laṅka phra men ma// sha za las dang 'jig rten gyi// pho nya g.yog 'khor pho mor bcas// gzugs dang cha lugs cho 'phrul ni// ma nges sna tshogs ci yang ston// dam tshig gis 'bod gnas 'dir gshegs// rdo rje'i rkang stabs dkyil 'khor bskor// brda dang brda len glu gar sgyur// rdo rje'i gar gyis lhag ma len// rnal 'byor drod nyul brda chos ston// la la tshogs khang dur khrod nyul/ */ bdud rtsi chang gi bshal chu sdud// la la mi sdug rnam 'gyur can// drag po'i ku 'debs 'o dod 'bod// sha khrag gtor ma'i lhag ma sdud// kun kyang dpal gyi pha 'bab 'di// khyer cig zo zhig tshim par mdzod// dam tshig can rnams srung ba dang*// de yi don rnams khyod kyis sgrubs// dam nyams rnams la bka' chad kyi// dmod pa'i sbyor bas brdegs nas kyang*// de yi sha khrag rus la rol// bdag gi phyi nang bar gcod sol// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// oṃ sarba a dhi pa ti kha kha khā hi khā hi utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ utstshiṣṭa bhakṣe bhyaḥswā hā/ zhes dbul/ de yang spro na tshigs bcad dang bcas pa/ mi spro na sngags kho nas dbul lo// gsum pa ni/ bum mdun gyi lha la chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod nas|

bsod nams 'di yis yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang*// gtso bo'i dbang bskur sku yi 'od zer nam mkha' khyab par grags pa yi// rdo rje rol par lhan cig srid gsum de yi go 'phang thob par shog /ces dge ba bsngo// dkyil 'khor la g.yon skor lan gsum bya/ shar sgor phyogs pas yig brgya lan gsum brjod la/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas// legs spyad 'di la nyes gyur gang*| |gang phyir lus can skyabs gyur pa// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol// gtso bo nus pa ma mchis shing*// ma rnyed pa dang ma tshang ba// 'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa// de kun mgon khyod bzod par gsol// so so'i skye bor gyur gang dang*// rnal 'byor ma thob dbang gis dang*// nye bar mkho ba med pa dang*// brjed dang shes bzhin ma yin pas// cung zhig cho ga nyer ma tshang*// de dag bkru zhing bzod par gsol// zhes nongs pa bshags/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ badzra muḥ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ du gyur nas rang gi srog rtsol nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig sna bug nas zhugs snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur par bsam/ bsod nams kyis ni 'gro ba rnams la ni// yun ring 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang*// bdag gzhan bde ba mchog ni bskyed gyur cig /de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms shing*// mchog tu mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /lha mo tshad ma sogs dang*/ bde ba phun tshogs sogs kyis smon lam gdab bo// shis brjod/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dang klu sgrub dril bu pa// dzā landha ra spyod pa'i rdo rje tilli pa// nā ro karṇa ri dang rdo rje gdan pa a bha ya// rtswa mi rga lo rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs ni// rmad byung mthu yis bdag cag mchod 'dod 'bras bu gang*// he ru ka dpal go 'phang mchog thob bkra shis stsol// bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi dbyings las legs byung zhing*// he ru ka dpal 'jigs byed rgyal po 'bar ba'i sku// shes rab phag mo'i padmar rdo rjes rol
